Projects subscribed by a Minka user

Source: R/mnk_user_proj.R
mnk_user_proj.Rd

Retrieves the projects to which a user is subscribed from the Minka page web, and returns them as a tibble.

Usage

mnk_user_proj(id_user)

Arguments

id_user

(numeric): A single integer number corresponding to the ID_user

Value

A tibble where each row is a project and the columns contain relevant information about the project. Returns an empty tibble if there are no projects or if an error occurs.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# It´s necesary to known the project_id
projects_for_user_6 <- mnk_user_proj(6)
print(projects_for_user_6)
} # }
